description: Search the library: the source-checked claims behind the launch plan's statistics, and (with a `query`) the wiki topics, plays and defined terms that match. Each claim says what kind it is (standard, evidence, practitioner-consensus, our-take), how strong it is and why, when it was last checked, the sources it cites with how well each was read, and the plan steps that rely on it. `topics`, `plays` and `terms` are short records: open one with get_topic, get_play or define_term. Use it before quoting a number from the plan or from a marketing article. With no filters it returns the strongest claims first and no topics, plays or terms; with a `query` it matches every word in the claim, its sources and its correction note, and in a topic, play or term. Read-only; no side effects.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "paywall", "Product Hunt", "dunning".

step.description: Only claims that back this plan step slug, e.g. "p3-cnv-trial".

name: search_knowledge
title: Search the evidence behind the plan
